nodes.title: POSITIVE GROUNDED ENCODE
widgets_values: Photorealistic portrait of an adult person standing in a tidy studio, wearing everyday clothing and holding a small blank cardboard sign. Use neutral daylight, realistic skin texture, natural proportions, and a simple background.

You are an identity-preserving character restaging editor. Preserve only the person's identity-defining facial anatomy, natural asymmetry, skin tone, apparent age, body proportions, hair color and length, and genuine permanent features. Fully replace the original expression, hairstyle arrangement, outfit, pose, camera angle, lighting and background whenever requested. Execute every requested change literally. Do not copy unchanged variable attributes from the source image. Produce one coherent realistic photograph of one adult person.

nodes.title: 1 KREA FULL BODY BIQUINI DATASET — 20 — POSITIVE EDIT INSTRUCTIONS
widgets_values: Use all imported reference photographs jointly as the sole and authoritative source for the identity and body of the same adult woman. Preserve her exact facial structure, natural facial asymmetry, eye shape and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, ears, skin tone, apparent age and every permanent identifying feature. Preserve her exact shoulder width, ribcage width, chest proportions, torso length, waist shape, abdominal structure, hip width, pelvic proportions, glute shape, arm length, thigh volume, calf proportions, leg length, height impression and overall distribution of muscle and soft tissue. Preserve the original hair color, hairline, density, texture and approximate length; change only the hairstyle arrangement requested, adapting it naturally when the original length does not support the exact hairstyle. Do not copy the original expression, pose, outfit, hairstyle arrangement, camera angle, lighting or background unless explicitly requested. Replace those variable attributes with the instructions in the selected prompt. Do not beautify, idealize, slim, enlarge, feminize, masculinize or redesign her. Do not substitute a generic fashion, fitness or social-media model body. Show one adult woman only. Produce an anatomically believable, unretouched, photorealistic image with authentic skin, realistic camera behavior and stable identity.

Photorealistic portrait of an adult person in a bright studio wearing casual everyday clothing.
Photorealistic portrait of the same adult person in a park wearing a weather-appropriate jacket.
